definition: [ תָּמַהּ ] verb be astounded, dumbfounded (Late Hebrew id.; so Aramaic תְּמַהּ , ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural תָּמָ֑הוּ Ps 48:6 Imperfect 2 masculine singular תִּתְמֶהּ Eccl 5:7 3 masculine plural יִתְמְהוּ Job 26:11 , etc.; Imperative masculine plural תְּמָ֑הוּ Isa 29:9 ; Hab 1:5 — be astounded Isa 29:9 ; Hab 1:5 (see Hithpa`el), Jer 4:9 (|| שׁמם , Niph`al), Ps 48:6 + מִן causative Job 26:11 + על of thing at which Exod 5:7 look in astonishment at אִישׁ אֶלרֵֿעֵהוּ ׳ ת Gen 43:33 ( J ), Isa 13:8 . Hithpa`el Imperative masculine plural + Qal Imperative וְהִתַּמְּהוּ תְּמָהוּ Hab 1:5 (see above), literally astonish yourselves, be astounded but We Hithpalpel הִתְמַהְמְהוּ ; Gr reads infinitive absolute תָּמַהַּ ( Marti and others וּתְמָהוּ ) for תמהו .
